theme_and_archetype.domain: Job Portal Registration Web App / Premium Fintech Flow
theme_and_archetype.archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) heavily modified to an Apple/Stripe Premium Trust aesthetic

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-slate-900

visual_enhancers.trust_badges: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-100 shadow-sm text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform

layout_and_spacing.step_container: h-full w-full overflow-y-auto px-4 md:px-8 pt-28 pb-32 max-w-3xl mx-auto flex flex-col
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Ample iOS-like padding. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Tap targets min 48px height.

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion_wrapper: Use <AnimatePresence mode='wait'> around the step content.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Radio cards should have a distinct active state with an Emerald border and subtle scale.

image_urls.description: Subtle white wavy texture. Use as an absolute background layer with 10% opacity and mix-blend-multiply to break the digital flatness.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Run `yarn add framer-motion canvas-confetti lucide-react` before starting.

STRICT APP ARCHITECTURE: The app MUST be a single-page React app mimicking a native mobile wizard. Use a `step` state (1, 2, or 3) to render screens conditionally inside a Framer Motion <AnimatePresence mode='wait'>.

NO VERTICAL SCROLLING BETWEEN SECTIONS: The main body/wrapper must be strictly `h-screen overflow-hidden`. Each active step component handles its own internal vertical scrolling. It must feel contained like an iOS app.

HEADER & PROGRESS: Create a globally fixed Header (`z-50`) at the top. It must contain the glowing logo 'JobsForAll Haryana' and a 3-step progress indicator (1. Start -> 2. Apply -> 3. Verify). Add a subtle 'Back' button for steps 2 and 3.

SCREEN 1 (START) & 3D CSS: Implement a completely CSS-based 3D floating illustration (e.g., a stylized briefcase or ID badge). DO NOT use an image for this. Create a layered CSS graphic using nested divs, `transform-style: preserve-3d`, `transform: rotateX(20deg) rotateY(-20deg)`, layered box-shadows, and a floating keyframe animation. Add glassmorphism trust badges below it and a massive magnetic CTA.

SCREEN 2 (APPLY): Form fields must feel extremely premium. Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match Stripe's form aesthetic. Use glowing blue borders on focus (`focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-blue-500/50`). Fields: Full Name, Phone, Email, District, Qualification (Select), Target Company (Select), Current Status (Radio Cards with distinct active states), Experience, Skills, LinkedIn. The continue button must show a spinner on click before advancing.

SCREEN 3 (VERIFY): Payment step. Top section should be a stylized floating white card mimicking a QR scanner but using the Lucide `QrCode` icon (scaled up) as a clean placeholder. Input for UTR transaction ID. A solid Emerald Green 'Verify & Complete Registration' button.

SUCCESS & GUARANTEE: Clicking 'Verify & Complete' must trigger a full-screen confetti effect using 'canvas-confetti' and transition to a success modal/state. The 30-day refund guarantee info box MUST be present in soft-blue on step 3 to build trust.
TESTING: Every single interactive element and key informational text MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="btn-start-registration"`).
